'''S-1A0''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] which served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was present at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />
